product.description: Founded in Herzogenaurach, adidas embodies a blend of sport and style, continuously pushing boundaries since its inception. With an iconic three-stripe mark, the brand crafts each piece with a vision of innovation and elevated streetwear aesthetics. Unleash a retro vibe with the Women's Handball Spezial (JP8718). Marrying high fashion and street culture, this classic & retro sneaker dazzles in a Lucid Pink colorway, perfect for turning heads. Designed for the Fall/Winter 2025, this silhouette is inspired by its athletic origins, embodying a timeless charm suited for lifestyle enthusiasts seeking a chic edge. Step out with an adidas icon that never goes out of style.

reviews.title: Birthday gift for my kid who loves these shoes
reviews.text:
I bought the Adidas Handball Spezial as a birthday gift for my daughter, and she absolutely loves them! The retro design and gum sole give them a timeless look, and the suede feels really high-quality.

Comfortable from the first wear, with no breaking-in needed. They’ve become her new favourite pair of trainers.

I’m really pleased with the purchase — stylish, comfortable, and a perfect gift. Highly recommended!
